caption:
A US doctor gave his family fortune to build a 300-bed cancer hospital in his hometown. In a rural part of Karnataka where patients once traveled hours for treatment.

Dr. Sampat Shivangi, a physician based in Jackson, Mississippi, funded a 300-bed cancer hospital in Belagavi, Karnataka, run by the KLE Society and inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu in January 2025. The hospital offers oncology specialities, radiation equipment, a palliative care unit and a chemotherapy daycare centre. His foundation also funded schools, community halls and other healthcare facilities across India.

He spent his career treating patients in Mississippi. He spent his savings building a hospital for patients he'd never meet, half a world away.

Sources: Deccan Herald, The Global Indian
